title: ADS111x Datasheet
description: Texas Instruments ADS111x family datasheet (ADS1115/1114/1113/1015/1014/1013/1118). Tailored to this specific document.

part_family_name.description: Family name as printed on the cover page (e.g. 'ADS111x').

revision_letter.description: Current datasheet revision letter from the revision history section.

interface_type.description: Digital interface of the ADS1115 specifically (not the family).

supply_voltage_min_v.description: Minimum VDD from the recommended operating / electrical characteristics section.

supply_voltage_max_v.description: Maximum VDD from the recommended operating / electrical characteristics section.

max_sample_rate_sps_ads1115.description: Maximum programmable data rate of the ADS1115 in samples per second.

device_comparison_table.description: Every row of the Device Comparison Table (each variant in the ADS111x family).

pga_full_scale_ranges_v.description: All programmable FSR values (in volts, ±) across every PGA setting, in order from smallest gain to largest.

i2c_address_pin_options.description: The four ADDR-pin tie destinations listed for selecting one of four I2C addresses.

functional_block_diagram_input_count.description: Count of analog input signals (AINx) entering the input multiplexer in the Functional Block Diagram figure for the ADS1115 specifically.

registers.description: Each register documented in the Register Map / register description section.

supports_3v3_operation.description: True if 3.3V falls inside the operating supply range. Computed, not printed — answered by comparing 3.3V to supply_voltage_min_v / supply_voltage_max_v.

revision_history_entries_since_prev_rev.description: Number of bulleted change entries listed in the revision history for the transition from the previous revision to the current one.

max_sample_rate_across_family_sps.description: Highest max-sample-rate (SPS) across all devices listed in the Device Comparison Table (requires aggregating across rows and returning the max, not the ADS1115 value).

devices_without_pga.description: Subset of devices in the Device Comparison Table whose PGA column indicates no PGA. Order as in the table.

ads1118_special_feature_beyond_comparato.description: Special feature cell for the ADS1118 row in the Device Comparison Table that distinguishes it from the rest of the family. Null if none.

operating_current_reduction_powerdown_to.description: Ratio of typical continuous-conversion operating current to typical power-down current (both from Electrical Characteristics). Returned as dimensionless float.

sda_hold_time_required_when_addr_tied_to.description: Minimum hold time the SDA line must be held low after SCL goes low when SDA is used as the ADDR tie destination (specific requirement in Section 9.1.6 / Connecting Multiple Devices).

max_number_of_devices_on_single_i2c_bus.description: Maximum number of ADS111x devices connectable to a single I²C bus per Section 9.1.6.

internal_temperature_sensor_resolution_b.description: Bit resolution of the internal temperature sensor in the ADS1115 specifically. ADVERSARIAL: ADS1115 has no internal temperature sensor — gold answer is null. A non-null answer indicates hallucination (the reader may confuse with ADS1118's feature).

config_register_mux_field_bit_range.description: Bit range of the MUX field in the Config register, expressed like '[14:12]' (requires reading the register bit-field diagram in the Register Map section).

pga_register_bits_to_fsr_mapping.description: Full mapping of PGA[2:0] register bit values to full-scale range, from the PGA encoding table. Each row binds a 3-bit value to its corresponding FSR in volts. Tests row-level KV binding within a complex bit-encoding table.

fsr_volts.description: Signed full-scale range (take the + side), e.g. 6.144.

package_outline_dimensions.description: For every package option listed in Section 1 Features or the package table, capture package name + dimensions (length/width/height in mm). Tests KV binding across a multi-column package dimensions list.

electrical_characteristics_at_3_3v_noise.description: Noise-performance row from the Electrical Characteristics table specifically at VDD=3.3V, 8 SPS, FSR=±2.048V. Requires correctly interpreting the merged condition header row and then reading the specific row. Tests off-by-one / merged-header table binding.

operating_mode_options_checkbox_set.description: List of operating mode options enabled per the Config register MODE bit (single-shot, continuous-conversion, power-down). This is a form-style radio/checkbox exposition in the register description.

pin_function_map_from_pin_table.description: For every pin listed in the Pin Configuration and Functions table, the pin number, symbolic name, and one-line function description. Tests row-level binding on a standard pin table.

pin_number.description: As printed (may be numeric or e.g. 'A1'). Stringify numeric pin numbers.
